summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting a material fact: the placement of dematerialized bearer bonds (Series AA-5, ticker BSTDA50822) in the local Chilean market under an existing line of credit. The bonds totaled 337,000 UF, mature February 1, 2032, and were placed at an average rate of 2.50%. This is a routine debt issuance by the bank, not a special situation. The filing includes no transaction regarding acquisitions, divestitures, or other special categories. The notice serves to comply with Chilean securities law disclosure requirements for a standard bond placement.
